parts.title: Accounting basics
parts.subtitle: Start here · No knowledge needed: what accounting is, the accounting equation, debits and credits, the books, the trial balance, then on to financial statements.

nodeData.note: Learn accounting step by step: start at the basics (no knowledge needed), then CPA Foundation, Intermediate and Advanced levels, plus Accounting at work in Kenya (iTax, eTIMS, payroll, Excel, month-end). Every map has worked examples in KES, flashcards, exam practice and videos. New maps are added every day. Notes are our own summaries with sources; they do not replace the official syllabus or study packs.
